messages:
ana: Proposal: add an "ephemerality" signal to error payloads/headers so SDKs and console can clearly distinguish transient vs persistent failures. Header+body field+telemetry+sampling.

matt: Sounds useful. Minimal wire format?

sophie: Current docs are vague; concrete header will make SDK retry semantics consistent.

ana (ana): Proposal details:
- header: x-rd-error-ephemerality: soft|sticky|terminal
- body: error.ephemerality optional string
- telemetry tags: error.ephemerality, error.kind, route.origin
- sampling: soft -> 10%, sticky/terminal -> 100%
- sampled events include x-rd-sample-id UUID
Example response snippet: HTTP/1.1 503, x-rd-error-kind: route, x-rd-error-ephemerality: soft, body.error.ephemerality: "soft" with hint.retry_after_seconds

infra-ops: Operational rule: if a fallback variant is used continuously >5s escalate soft->sticky and emit ephemerality_escalation event with previous/new.

ryan: Console mapping idea: soft -> amber "degraded" badge + sampled traces; sticky -> red "restricted" + runbook link + full sampling; terminal -> red "error" + alerts/SLA.

matt: SDK UX: soft -> "transient capacity issue — retry with backoff"; sticky -> "routing degraded — consider dedicated or reduce concurrency"; terminal -> show error + runbook link.

sophie: Console feature: samples tab keyed by x-rd-sample-id (PII scrubbed) for real payloads to aid triage.

ana: Rollout plan: 1) emit header/body behind flag (staging), 2) telemetry tags + sampling, 3) SDK mapping PR canary, 4) console badges + samples tab.

matt: Backcompat: header-only addition is nonbreaking; body optional. Add migration tests.

deploy-bot: route.add-ephemerality flag enabled in staging 2026-03-20T10:05Z.

ryan: Actions: ana write RFC with examples & metrics (EOD Thu), matt SDK PR, infra-ops create escalation alert, sophie console mockups. I'll coordinate dates after RFC.

ana: Will post RFC link in #eng-platform when ready.
